verdict.rationale: Postmark's Servers API lets you create, list, edit and delete servers programmatically. Each server authenticates with its own Server API token, which gives per-tenant credential isolation, and message streams, sender signatures, the Domains API and unlimited custom sending domains (on higher plans) support multi-domain tenants. Separate reputation is only evidenced through dedicated IPs, which require 300k+ emails per month. Per-tenant suppression lists are only implied by the per-server Bounce API. Missing for 10: explicit per-server/per-stream suppression list docs, reputation isolation below the dedicated-IP threshold, a documented multi-tenant/subaccount guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.
